_comment: MkDocs Material `:material-<name>:` shortcode -> Iconify lucide name. The docs site draws the product UI's icon set (lucide, via @iconify-json/lucide) so a concept is the same glyph in the app and in the docs; Starlight's built-in set has no equivalent for network/robot/key/bell/package. Read by scripts/port_mkdocs.py (conversion) and src/components/Card.astro (rendering).
